newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabawe Wankie H1 coal sales fall 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabawe Wankie H1 coal sales fall 17 pct.

text.p: Zimbabwe's Wankie Colliery Co Ltd sold a total of 1.9 million tonnes of coal for the six months ended August 31, compared to 2.3 million tonnes in the same period last year, the company said.

The company said in a statement on Thursday that the lower sales for the first half of this year were due to low demand from the national Zimbabwe Electricity Supply Authority power stations which were being refurbished.

It also said a decision by the company to make coal supplies available to the beleaguered state-owned Zimbabwe Iron and Steel Co (ZISCO) on a cash up-front basis had an adverse impact on its normal offtake.
ZISCO owes Wankie Colliery about Z$100 million, it said.
